about: Birthplaces and places of death resolved against GeoNames (geonames.org, CC BY 4.0) by the local places tool (quality/places/gazetteer.py), only where something narrows a name to one place: the only place of the name, the printed municipality, the unit's own region, a town far bigger than the rest, a well-known mountain, river or region. units: data file -> field -> the field as stored -> GeoNames id, or [id, the field with its village in the nominative, 1 if the printed form can only be a case (else 0: only where the entry prints a preposition before it)]. places: id -> [lat, lon].
